description: Comprehensive training dataset for Presentation Deck Generation, Slide Layout Design, python-pptx Automation, and Pitch Decks

training_data.prompt: Create a 10-slide executive presentation outline for a corporate AI Strategy launch

completion.theme: Modern Dark Glassmorphism / Cyber Teal Accent

training_data.prompt: Write a Python script using `python-pptx` to programmatically build custom formatted PowerPoint slides

completion.code_snippet:
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor

def generate_deck(title_text, subtitle_text, output_path='presentation.pptx'):
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
    prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    tx_box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1.0), Inches(2.0), Inches(11.333), Inches(2.0))
    tf = tx_box.text_frame
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = title_text
    p.font.size = Pt(44)
    p.font.bold = True
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(15, 23, 42)
    prs.save(output_path)
    return output_path
